7SABER is a brand developed by the London Institute of Identity (INSTID) and Tashkent agency GRANDPR, officially launched on June 25, 2021. One of their products is the Saber Sneakers, which are priced at $86. They are available in various colors including Serene, Tiffany, Dirty Blue, Sand, Light Green, Light Blue, Olive, Light Brown, Lilac, Khaki, Turquoise, Orange, Black, and Dark Blue. The sizes available range from 41 to 48. Here are some images of the Saber Sneakers:
